answer.rationale: Do not answer the competitor price cut with promotional pricing: the recovered price-sensitive SMB experiment increased signup and near-term qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, directly conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Broadly deploy the confirmed shortened/simplified onboarding improvements instead; they improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. This is not proven to neutralize competitor-driven price churn, so price-churn risk remains explicitly flagged.
